name: @sparkling-example/vue-router-mpa
description: Vue Router driving Sparkling multi-page native navigation (MPA) via sparkling-history.

scripts.build: pnpm -C ../.. --filter sparkling-method --filter sparkling-navigation --filter sparkling-history build && rspeedy build
scripts.dev:web-shell: rspeedy build --environment web && LYNX_BUNDLE_DIR="$PWD/dist" pnpm --filter sparkling-web-shell dev
